title: Psalm 72 (His Name Shall Endure)
lyrics_original: All nations shall call Him blessed.
And blessed be His glorious name
And let the whole earth be filled
And blessed be His glorious name
And let the whole earth be filled

bible_verses.english: May his name endure forever. May his name increase as long as the sun. May men be blessed by him. May all nations call him blessed.

Of the increase of his government and of peace there will be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from then on, even forever. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.
The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord, and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, Your name is exalted above all others, enduring through every generation. Thank You for the wondrous things You do in my life and across the whole earth. Teach me to rest in Your eternal reign when the world around me feels uncertain. May my life bring honor to Your glorious name today and every day. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, Your name is exalted above all others, enduring through every generation. Thank You for the wondrous things You do in my life and across the whole earth. Teach me to rest in Your eternal reign when the world around me feels uncertain. May my life bring honor to Your glorious name today and every day. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Long after earthly kingdoms rise and fall, the glorious name of Jesus remains constant and unbroken. This beautiful psalm reminds us that His reign brings true peace and blessing to every corner of the earth. When we lift our voices in worship, we align our hearts with an eternal kingdom that outshines the sun. May you find quiet comfort today knowing that the God who works wonders holds your life securely in His enduring hands.
